title: 2026 Nevada gubernatorial election
description: Nevada’s 2026 gubernatorial election will choose the state’s next governor, with incumbent Republican Joe Lombardo seeking re-election against Democratic Attorney General Aaron Ford. The race is important because Nevada is a closely divided swing state where statewide contests are often decided by narrow margins. Lombardo and Ford offer a clear partisan contrast, with Republicans aiming to hold the governorship and Democrats trying to flip it back. Early public polling has shown a competitive contest, with both candidates emphasizing affordability, the economy, housing, and state leadership.

candidates.name: Joe Lombardo
candidates.summary: Joe Lombardo is the incumbent governor of Nevada and a Republican seeking re-election in 2026. Before becoming governor, he served as Clark County sheriff from 2015 to 2023.

Economy.stance: Lombardo says he favors pro-growth, business-friendly policies and highlights job growth and investment as evidence of his approach. His campaign also emphasizes tax and regulatory policies aimed at supporting small businesses and economic development.

sources.title: Taxes & The Economy - Joe Lombardo for Governor
Lombardo Statement on Nevada Ranking in Job Growth

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Lombardo says he is personally pro-life but opposes a Nevada abortion ban and says the state’s abortion rights should be decided by voters rather than politicians. He also says he supports access to contraception and would not prosecute women seeking legal abortions or providers performing them.

sources.title: Reproductive Health - Joe Lombardo for Governor
A note from Joe Lombardo - Joe Lombardo for Governor

Immigration.stance: Lombardo supports stronger border security, opposes sanctuary cities, and backs cooperation with federal immigration authorities. His campaign has said he would use state resources to assist federal enforcement efforts.

sources.title: Immigration and Sanctuary Cities - Joe Lombardo for Governor
Lombardo to authorize Nevada National Guard to support ICE operations - The Nevada Independent

Firearms & Second Amendment.stance: Lombardo says he supports Second Amendment rights for law-abiding Nevadans. He opposes gun registries and red flag laws, supports background checks, and says he would partner with law enforcement to reduce gun violence.

sources.title: Second Amendment - Joe Lombardo for Governor
NSSF – Governor Lombardo Stands Up for the Second Amendment

Healthcare.stance: Lombardo says he supports expanding access to health care and lowering costs, including through hospital transparency, patient protections, and broader system reforms. His administration has also promoted a Nevada Health Care Access Act to address access and affordability.

sources.title: Lombardo's bill seeks to fix what ails Nevada health care
Lombardo highlights expanded patient protections under Nevada hospital transparency law
Governor Lombardo Admin 3Year Plan

Foreign Policy.stance: Lombardo has said Iran must not obtain a nuclear weapon and that diplomacy should be pursued, but that all options remain on the table if diplomacy fails. His comments frame the issue as a national security concern rather than a state policy area.

sources.title: Governor Joe Lombardo addresses U.S. attack on Iran - Fox5 Vegas

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Lombardo has backed a ballot initiative to require girls’ and women’s sports to be played by athletes based on sex assigned at birth, and he has framed the measure as a fairness issue for women’s athletics. The proposal has also faced legal challenges and court review.

sources.title: AP News: Lombardo leads 2026 ballot initiative to block transgender athletes from female sports
The Nevada Independent: Lombardo touted women's sports measure as a 'vote getter' for reelection

Education.stance: Lombardo supports expanding school choice in Nevada, including charter schools, opportunity scholarships, and education savings accounts. He also emphasizes early literacy, open enrollment, workforce development, accountability, and school safety.

sources.title: Education - Joe Lombardo for Governor
Lombardo says traditional education is not working. His answer? Expand school choice.

Election Policy.stance: Lombardo supports voter ID, ending ballot harvesting, ending universal mail-in ballots, and creating a bipartisan panel to oversee Nevada elections. His campaign presents these changes as election-security measures.

sources.title: Election Integrity - Joe Lombardo for Governor
The Lombardo Agenda for Securing Our Elections

Local Issues.stance: Lombardo has emphasized housing affordability and supply, including support for the Nevada Housing Access and Attainability Act and related state funding for new housing projects. His campaign and administration frame housing as a cost-of-living issue.

sources.title: Results - Joe Lombardo for Governor
Projects partly funded by governor's housing bill take off, aiming at affordability crisis

Tech & AI.stance: Lombardo has said he supports data centers and technology-sector growth because they bring jobs, investment, and economic growth to Nevada. He has also said such development should be managed so costs are not shifted to residents or local businesses.

sources.title: I support data centers because they bring jobs, investment, and economic growth to Nevada
Alaska and Nevada Governors on Innovation and Economic Growth

Climate/Energy.stance: Lombardo has moved Nevada's climate and energy policy toward prioritizing energy production and economic development. His administration released a revised climate plan and Nevada exited the U.S. Climate Alliance under Executive Order 2023-007.

sources.title: Nevada governor releases revised climate plan after lengthy delay - AP News
Nevada utilities back Lombardo in governor's race

career_history.description: Led the Clark County Sheriff’s Office before entering statewide office.

candidates.voting_summary: Joe Lombardo is an incumbent governor, not a legislator, so there is no legislative voting record to report. As governor, Vote Smart shows he has signed legislation including AB 3 and SB 3, indicating executive approval of measures on public-record confidentiality and state assistance policy. Sources: https://justfacts.votesmart.org/candidate/204056/joseph-lombardo ; https://votesmart.org/bill/41635/115779/204056/joseph-lombardo-signed-ab-3-authorizes-public-officials-to-make-their-personal-records-confidential ; https://votesmart.org/bill/41639/115793/204056/joseph-lombardo-signed-sb-3-establishes-the-silver-state-general-assistance-program
candidates.donor_summary: Joe Lombardo’s campaign finance profile shows fundraising dominated by gaming/casino interests, utilities, and other business-sector donors, with OpenSecrets donor records showing repeated $5,000 contributions from entities such as Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino and Venetian Las Vegas Gaming LLC. Nevada reporting and news coverage indicate he has raised roughly $15 million in the 2026 cycle and held more than $9 million cash on hand, with a large share of 2025 fundraising coming from donors using Nevada’s contribution-limit loophole structure. candidates.name: Aaron Ford
candidates.summary: Aaron Ford is Nevada’s attorney general and a Democratic candidate for governor in 2026. He has also served in the Nevada Senate and has centered his campaign on affordability, housing, health care, and consumer protection.

summary_sources.title: AG Aaron Ford - Nevada Attorney General

Healthcare.stance: Ford says he would lower health care costs by capping prescription drug prices at Medicare-negotiated levels, relieving medical debt, and cracking down on pharmacy benefit managers and fraudulent billing practices.

sources.title: Aaron Ford Unveils Second Plank of ‘Affordable Nevada’ Agenda: Health Care
Issues — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor

Economy.stance: Ford’s economic message focuses on lowering the cost of living, especially housing and utility bills. His campaign says he would crack down on corporate homebuying, ban junk fees, and oppose tariff-driven price increases.

sources.title: Issues — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor
Housing — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor
Energy — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor

Climate/Energy.stance: Ford says he would prioritize clean and affordable energy, oppose mandatory demand charges, expand residential solar and energy-efficiency incentives, and require large energy users such as data centers to pay their share of infrastructure and water costs.

sources.title: Energy — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor
Issues — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Ford supports reproductive freedom and access to contraception and abortion services. His campaign and attorney general office have highlighted support for reproductive health access and endorsements from reproductive-rights groups.

sources.title: Attorney General Ford Defends Access to Birth Control and Other Contraceptive Care
Reproductive Freedom For All Endorses Attorney General Aaron Ford for Governor

Immigration.stance: Ford has backed Nevada’s model immigration policies, which limit state and local cooperation with immigration enforcement in schools, health care facilities, and public institutions. He has also said immigration enforcement should remain a federal responsibility rather than a state sanctuary policy.

sources.title: Attorney General Ford Announces Publication of Model Immigration Policies
Ford Responds to Lombardo on Model Immigration Policies

Firearms & Second Amendment.stance: Ford has supported gun-safety enforcement and opposed a Postal Service rule that would have allowed handguns to be mailed. His public comments framed the proposal as undermining federal gun law and gun safety.

sources.title: Attorney General Ford Opposes Postal Service Rule Undermining Federal Gun Law

Education.stance: Ford’s education agenda includes universal free meals, expanded career and technical education, reading support, early childhood education, and stronger support for teachers. He has also said he would continue fighting for school funding and student loan relief.

sources.title: Aaron Ford Holds Education Roundtable with Southern Nevada Educators, Parents, and Students
Issues — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Ford says he will defend voting rights and fair housing protections. His campaign has criticized Supreme Court decisions weakening the Voting Rights Act and his office has joined coalitions opposing rollbacks of fair housing rules.

sources.title: Attorney General Ford Slams Supreme Court Gutting the Voting Rights Act
Attorney General Ford Joins Coalition Opposing Rollback of Crucial Fair Housing Regulations

Tech & AI.stance: Ford supports restricting the use of algorithms and AI for rent-setting by corporate landlords and says Nevada should adopt responsible AI and data-privacy rules that protect consumers.

sources.title: Housing — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor
Issues — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor

Election Policy.stance: Ford has criticized efforts he describes as federal overreach into Nevada elections and has framed voting access and election administration as state priorities. No detailed standalone election-policy platform was found on the campaign site.

sources.title: Attorney General Ford Statement on President Trump’s Latest Attempts to Federalize Nevada’s Elections
Attorney General Ford Slams Supreme Court Gutting the Voting Rights Act

Local Issues.stance: Ford’s local agenda centers on housing affordability in Nevada, including capping security deposits at one month’s rent, banning junk fees, expanding rental and down-payment assistance, and using vacant or federal land for new housing.

sources.title: Housing — Aaron Ford for Nevada Governor
Aaron Ford Unveils First Plank of ‘Affordable Nevada’ Agenda: Housing

career_history.description: Served in the Nevada Senate before winning statewide office.

candidates.voting_summary: Aaron Ford is a non-legislator in this race; he has not held legislative office, so there is no legislative voting record to report. His comparable governing record is as Nevada attorney general, and Ballotpedia identifies him as the state’s attorney general since 2019, while his campaign and public statements emphasize election administration, consumer protection, and education-related priorities. Sources: https://ballotpedia.org/Aaron_Ford_(Nevada) ; https://justfacts.votesmart.org/officials/NV/S/Nevada-statewide ; https://www.fordfornevada.com/news/ford-raises-record-breaking-haul-in-nevada-governor-race
candidates.donor_summary: Aaron Ford’s fundraising is dominated by legal, gaming, and business-sector donors, with OpenSecrets showing a total of about $3.44 million raised in the current cycle and top contributors including Station Casinos and Zuffa LLC dba UFC at $5,000 each in the cited profile. FollowTheMoney also tracks his state-level finance history, and campaign/news reports say he raised nearly $1.5 million in the first quarter of 2026 for the governor’s race. candidates.name: Alexis Hill
candidates.summary: Alexis Hill is a Washoe County commissioner representing District 1 and the Democratic candidate for governor of Nevada. Her campaign emphasizes affordability, public services, and state revenue reform, drawing on her local-government experience in Washoe County.

Healthcare.stance: Alexis Hill says her campaign platform includes healthcare as part of supporting families and making Nevada more affordable. Her issues page does not lay out a detailed healthcare policy proposal, but it frames healthcare access and affordability as part of a broader family-support agenda.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Economy.stance: Alexis Hill proposes a revenue-focused economic agenda that she says would end tax giveaways to large corporations, modernize state revenue, and use higher taxes on corporations and wealthy interests to fund schools, roads, housing, and other public services. Her campaign also says it would freeze residential rent increases and insurance premiums and require higher wages from companies receiving tax abatements.

sources.title: Alexis Hill for Nevada Governor
Issues - Alexis Hill

Immigration.stance: Alexis Hill says immigration policy should be handled through comprehensive federal reform rather than state-run detention centers. She supports partnering with federal agencies for due process and humane treatment, and says she does not support using the Nevada National Guard for immigration roundups.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Civil Rights & Equality.stance: Alexis Hill says she supports LGBTQ+ rights, privacy, Native American sovereign rights and resources, and voter rights protections. Her campaign presents these as part of a broader civil-liberties and human-rights agenda.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Climate/Energy.stance: Alexis Hill says Nevada should strengthen protections for air, water, land, and climate, and she points to Washoe County's first sustainability plan as part of her record. Her campaign links climate policy to conservation, resilience, and quality of life.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Tech & AI.stance: Alexis Hill says Nevada should modernize its digital infrastructure and has also criticized data-center tax breaks and called for stronger guardrails around data-center growth and AI deployment. Her campaign ties these issues to ratepayer protection, water use, and workforce protections.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill
Democratic candidate for governor Alexis Hill slams data-center tax breaks

Election Policy.stance: Alexis Hill says Nevada should strengthen voter-information protections, support faster and verifiable vote counting, and properly fund local election offices and registrars. She frames these changes as necessary to protect democracy and election fairness.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Local Issues.stance: Alexis Hill's local-government platform focuses on roads, homelessness, housing, parks, and school funding. She says she wants to use state revenue reform and local investment to improve basic services and quality of life for Nevada families.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Abortion & Reproductive Health.stance: Alexis Hill says she is a staunch supporter of the right to choose and has been endorsed by Planned Parenthood Action in previous runs for office. Her campaign page does not provide additional detail on abortion policy beyond support for reproductive choice.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

Education.stance: Alexis Hill says Nevada should close its education funding gap, expand universal pre-K, provide free school breakfast and lunch, raise teacher pay, and expand career, technical, apprenticeship, and adult workforce programs. She also says property tax reform is needed to sustainably increase school funding.

sources.title: Issues - Alexis Hill

flags.concern: The summary correctly states that Lombardo is an incumbent governor with no legislative voting record, but then cites Vote Smart links and mentions bills he 'signed' (AB 3, SB 3). This is not contradictory — executive approval is appropriately documented — but the phrasing 'signed legislation' could be clarified to avoid confusion with legislative voting.
flags.suggestion: Minor: Consider rephrasing as 'As governor, Vote Smart shows he has approved legislation including AB 3 and SB 3...' to be more precise about the executive vs. legislative distinction.

flags.concern: Aaron Ford is correctly described as holding no legislative office in the current race, but the summary notes he 'has not held legislative office.' His career history shows he served in the Nevada Senate 2013-2019, which IS legislative experience. The summary should clarify: he does not currently hold legislative office, but he has prior legislative experience.
flags.suggestion: Revise to: 'Aaron Ford currently holds executive office (attorney general) rather than legislative office, so there is no current legislative voting record to report. However, he served in the Nevada State Senate 2013-2019; his current governing record is as attorney general.'

flags.concern: The donor summary for Aaron Ford cites OpenSecrets and FollowTheMoney URLs, but the specific figures and donor names ('Station Casinos,' 'Zuffa LLC dba UFC' at '$5,000 each') are difficult to independently verify from the description alone. The phrasing 'cited profile' is somewhat circular — it refers back to itself. This is not an error, but the claim would benefit from explicit date/cycle clarity in human review.
flags.suggestion: When human-reviewing donor data, verify OpenSecrets cycles and dates match the 2026 race. Confirm that Station Casinos and Zuffa LLC are actual top donors in the 2026 cycle (not a prior cycle).

flags.concern: Lombardo's stance is summarized as 'personally pro-life but opposes a Nevada abortion ban.' This could benefit from explicit sourcing within the stance text itself, as it is a politically sensitive nuance. The sources (official_policy_page and official_statement) are cited, so the stance is supported, but readers should be aware this is Lombardo's stated position, not a neutral characterization.
flags.suggestion: No change needed if sources support the claim. Consider brief in-text attribution ('Lombardo says he is personally pro-life but opposes...') for extra clarity, though current sourcing is adequate.

flags.concern: Alexis Hill's donor summary explicitly acknowledges that 'the most concrete public figures available in the sources reviewed are her filing records rather than a fully detailed industry breakdown.' This is transparent and appropriate for a candidate with lower fundraising totals or less publicly detailed donor breakdowns. No issue here, but this is a good example of honest gap-flagging.
flags.suggestion: No change needed. This is exemplary transparency.

flags.concern: Polling data includes a Noble Predictive Insights poll dated 2026-03-13 and three other polls. The dates range from 2025-11-18 to 2026-05-16. All appear internally consistent with the race timeline. However, the profile's 'updated_utc' timestamp is 2026-05-17T00:28:43, which is after the last poll date (2026-05-16), so data appears current. No factual issue, but this should be spot-checked to confirm these are real poll releases and not synthetic examples.
flags.suggestion: Human reviewer should verify that Noble Predictive Insights, Emerson College Polling, and RealClearPolitics actually published these specific polls on the stated dates and with the stated matchups.

reviews.summary: This is a well-researched, comprehensive profile of the 2026 Nevada gubernatorial race with strong sourcing across all three major candidates. The profile demonstrates consistent factual accuracy, neutral language, and appropriate confidence ratings. Career histories are properly documented with credible sources (Ballotpedia, official government pages, Vote Smart). Issue positions are extensively sourced from official campaign sites, news outlets, and government records. The profile appropriately flags low-confidence positions and acknowledges gaps (e.g., 'No public position found' for Ford on Foreign Policy, Hill on Firearms). Polling data is well-structured and dated. The only minor areas for improvement involve incomplete education fields and a few sources that warrant spot-checking by human review, but these do not materially affect the profile's quality or accuracy.

flags.concern: The summary of Aaron Ford's stance is based on a specific, narrow action (opposing a Postal Service rule), which may not fully capture his broader Second Amendment platform.
flags.suggestion: If additional campaign material becomes available, consider expanding this to reflect a more comprehensive view of his gun policy, as 'medium' confidence correctly reflects.

flags.concern: The Emerson College poll dated 2026-05-15 lists a sample size of 1000 and a 50/50 split, but the provided URL (https://emersoncollegepolling.com/nevada-2026-poll/) is a generic landing page or potentially non-specific to this exact data point.
flags.suggestion: Verify that the specific poll results cited for 2026-05-15 map to the provided URL or update the link to a direct report/press release page.

reviews.summary: This is an excellent, high-quality candidate profile. The research is thoroughly documented with active, credible sources ranging from official campaign platforms to local Nevada news outlets. The profile maintains a neutral, objective tone throughout, carefully attributing stances to the candidates' own materials, and correctly handles the absence of public information by assigning low confidence levels rather than guessing. The background and legislative context for all candidates are well-structured.
